transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Yes, this is Chloe. I was actually hoping to hear from you—my apologies for the missed payment. I had an unexpected car repair that threw my budget off, but I’m definitely looking to make things right. Is there a way we can discuss setting up a payment plan? Thank you for your time.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi Chloe, thank you for getting back to me—my name is Sarah Thompson, and I’m a debt resolution specialist here at ClearPath Financial Solutions. I appreciate you reaching out; it shows you’re taking this seriously, and I’m here to help you get back on track.

First, I want to acknowledge that unexpected expenses—like car repairs—can really shake things up. I’m glad you’re ready to work on a solution, and we can absolutely explore a payment plan that fits your current situation.

Before we go over your options, would you be comfortable sharing a bit more about how your budget looks right now? For example, what do you feel would be a manageable amount to put toward this debt each month? This helps me make sure any plan we set up is realistic and sustainable for you.
